n21dde4b1fe.headline: The Government seeks to raise at least $320 million with the sale of five corruption assets closely linked to Cristina Kirchner
n21dde4b1fe.summary: The Argentine government plans to raise at least $320 million by auctioning five assets linked to corruption cases involving former officials and associates.
n21dde4b1fe.why: Asset sales linked to corruption cases can affect government finances and investor perceptions of political risk.
